ownerDecision.scope: Two more original Polish game concepts on the PT-84 Orzeł's base (profiles/oplotBM.ts, variants 'pls' and 'plz'): the PT-84 Sokół, a lighter long-range hunter at IX, and the PT-84 Żbik, a heavy assault tank at X. Poland never fielded the Oplot; both are what-ifs in the fleet's Polish Krata language.

pt84_sokol.silhouette: Polish game concept, the light hunter on the T-84BM Oplot-M's hull, running gear and welded turret: framed ERAWA-2 Krata grids on the glacis (two 3 x 3 fields), the welded cheek boxes and the three forward skirt panels only, plain welded flank boxes; one low ZSMU-1276 with a 12.7 mm WKM-B; a telescopic sensor mast raised 1.9 m over the bustle with its optronic head; Tellur banks, the round PCO panoramic head, Obra-3 heads, the rear stowage box and field basket, drums; the 120 mm KBM2 without the gun-launched missile

pt84_zbik.silhouette: Polish game concept, the assault tank on the T-84BM Oplot-M's hull, running gear and welded turret: Krata-2 grids of two-layer bevelled ERAWA-2 pillows flush with 10 cm frames on the glacis, the cheek boxes, the turret flanks and every skirt panel; a full-width dozer blade across the nose; two ZSMU-1276 stations on towers (12.7 mm WKM-B, 7.62 mm UKM-2000); a searchlight on each cheek box; the bustle slat cage; Tellur banks, the PCO panoramic head, Obra-3 heads, the rear stowage box and basket, drums; the 120 mm KBM2
